title: The Leg
question: What's its everyday name?
lines: One bone in your knee floats inside a tendon. Name it.
Watch the small flat bone that's glowing.
What's the everyday name of this bone?
The shinbone is the long bone just below the knee.
This small bone sits in the quadriceps tendon.
It's C. The kneecap, or patella.
Why it matters: it gives your thigh muscles better leverage.

title: The Leg
question: Which bone is glowing?
lines: This is the biggest bone in your foot. Can you name it?
Watch the bone at the back of the foot that's glowing.
The talus sits above it and meets the shinbone.
This one forms the heel and anchors the Achilles tendon.
It's B. The calcaneus, or heel bone.
Why it matters: it takes your weight every time your heel lands.
